code_examples.code:
class CapStyleVariants(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        arcs = VGroup(*[
            Arc(
                radius=1,
                start_angle=0,
                angle=TAU / 4,
                stroke_width=20,
                color=GREEN,
                cap_style=cap_style,
            )
            for cap_style in CapStyleType
        ])
        arcs.arrange(RIGHT, buff=1)
        self.add(arcs)
        for arc in arcs:
            label = Text(arc.cap_style.name, font_size=24).next_to(arc, DOWN)
            self.add(label)
